cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(IPRBurstControls LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
get_filename_component(IPR_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
find_package(Qt6 6.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Quick Concurrent)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc imgcodecs)
find_package(TIFF REQUIRED)
if(NOT IPR_ENGINE_BUILD OR NOT LIBRAW_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "IPR_ENGINE_BUILD and LIBRAW_LIBRARY are required")
endif()
add_library(iprEngine STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(iprEngine PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${IPR_ENGINE_BUILD}/Release/iprEngine.lib")
add_executable(iprBurstControls burst_controls.cpp "${IPR_ROOT}/src/tools/TestRecipes.cpp")
foreach(folder app cache core editor profiles providers raw tools)
    target_include_directories(iprBurstControls PRIVATE "${IPR_ROOT}/src/${folder}")
endforeach()
target_include_directories(iprBurstControls PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(iprBurstControls PRIVATE iprEngine Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Quick Qt6::Concurrent TIFF::TIFF ${OpenCV_LIBS} "${LIBRAW_LIBRARY}")
qt_add_resources(iprBurstControls ipr_ui_defaults PREFIX "/" BASE "${IPR_ROOT}"
    FILES "${IPR_ROOT}/config/ipr-ui.ini" "${IPR_ROOT}/config/raw-normalization.json")
add_executable(iprBurstReference burst_controls.cpp "${IPR_ROOT}/src/tools/TestRecipes.cpp")
target_compile_definitions(iprBurstReference PRIVATE IPR_REFERENCE_CONTEXT=1)
foreach(folder app cache core editor profiles providers raw tools)
    target_include_directories(iprBurstReference PRIVATE "${IPR_ROOT}/src/${folder}")
endforeach()
target_include_directories(iprBurstReference PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(iprBurstReference PRIVATE iprEngine Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Quick Qt6::Concurrent TIFF::TIFF ${OpenCV_LIBS} "${LIBRAW_LIBRARY}")
qt_add_resources(iprBurstReference ipr_ui_defaults_reference PREFIX "/" BASE "${IPR_ROOT}"
    FILES "${IPR_ROOT}/config/ipr-ui.ini" "${IPR_ROOT}/config/raw-normalization.json")
add_executable(iprNoiseSingleAudit single_image_audit.cpp "${IPR_ROOT}/src/tools/TestRecipes.cpp")
foreach(folder app cache core editor profiles providers raw tools)
    target_include_directories(iprNoiseSingleAudit PRIVATE "${IPR_ROOT}/src/${folder}")
endforeach()
target_include_directories(iprNoiseSingleAudit PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(iprNoiseSingleAudit PRIVATE iprEngine Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Quick Qt6::Concurrent TIFF::TIFF ${OpenCV_LIBS} "${LIBRAW_LIBRARY}")
qt_add_resources(iprNoiseSingleAudit ipr_ui_defaults_single PREFIX "/" BASE "${IPR_ROOT}"
    FILES "${IPR_ROOT}/config/ipr-ui.ini" "${IPR_ROOT}/config/raw-normalization.json")

add_executable(iprOpeningTransportProbe opening_transport_probe.cpp "${IPR_ROOT}/src/tools/TestRecipes.cpp")
target_compile_definitions(iprOpeningTransportProbe PRIVATE IPR_WITH_LIBRAW=1)
get_filename_component(IPR_RAW_LIBRARY_DIR "${LIBRAW_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
find_path(IPR_PROBE_LIBRAW_INCLUDE_DIR libraw/libraw.h HINTS "${IPR_RAW_LIBRARY_DIR}/../../include" REQUIRED)
foreach(folder app cache core editor profiles providers raw tools)
    target_include_directories(iprOpeningTransportProbe PRIVATE "${IPR_ROOT}/src/${folder}")
endforeach()
target_include_directories(iprOpeningTransportProbe PRIVATE ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS} "${IPR_PROBE_LIBRAW_INCLUDE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(iprOpeningTransportProbe PRIVATE iprEngine Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Quick Qt6::Concurrent TIFF::TIFF ${OpenCV_LIBS} "${LIBRAW_LIBRARY}")
qt_add_resources(iprOpeningTransportProbe ipr_ui_defaults_transport PREFIX "/" BASE "${IPR_ROOT}"
    FILES "${IPR_ROOT}/config/ipr-ui.ini" "${IPR_ROOT}/config/raw-normalization.json")

units: Float at pre-RCD after /65535, camera RGB and post-DCP Rec2020; variance/covariance in squared stage units.
limitations: Two captures per pair, three spatial crops only; paired residuals can contain motion and lighting/WB changes. Not clean truth or visual denoise comparison. Profiles and gains can differ across black/scene captures: do not subtract their RGB covariances without transport. Probe reuses unmodified decoder internals via test-only white-box include; baseline equality guards both camera and DCP output. Diagnostics run neutral with optics off only; edits/optical resampling not covered. No raw-floating alternative implemented or IA inference, source deletion, production change or final sealed burst access.
